messages:
Maya T.: FYI we have an escalated customer (org: org-7312) saying audit log entries are missing for 2025-10-02 -> 2025-10-04. They want confirmation of retention, a signed evidence pack, and timeline for when we notified them. Also asking whether KMS access logs include export events.

infra-bot: Incident auto-ack — created ticket INC-7312. Assigning to @Samir and @Ethan R..

Ethan R.: Can you drop org ID and the customer request email? Need to scope whether this is a retention window or a search/filter issue. Also: did they request a full HSM export?

Jules C.: Customer says they did an 'bulk export' via the API and didn't see matching audit entries. Asking for proof we didn't export keys or data.

Samir: I can run a log export. Quick repro: show me the request id or approximate timestamps. Likely it's a query mismatch (we've seen timezone off-by-one before).

Maya T.: Pasted customer email (redacted): '…we triggered export at ~2025-10-02T18:12:34Z and there are no audit lines for that job. Please provide audit evidence and KMS access records.'

Ethan R.: Ok. For KMS/HSM access we need to check key-use logs and HSM audit. I'll pull key usage and sign operations. Samir — do we have a playbook for evidence pack? If not, suggest this structure: 1) raw audit log slice, 2) key usage timeline, 3) manifest of exported objects, 4) chain of custody note.

Jules C.: Customer wants ETA on evidence pack and any customer notification timeline. They're escalated to legal/compliance on their side.

LegalOps Bot: For customer-facing evidence, we need to redact user identifiers and include statement on retention policy. Please loop in @LegalOps to approve wording before sending. Note: do not share HSM private keys or key material.

LegalOps: Confirmed — we can approve a redacted evidence pack. We need to know if any PII is involved and whether the export contained any encrypted payloads requiring additional CAs. Draft comms should avoid technical details about HSM internals.

Samir: Ran quick query, here's the command I used:
```
rlogs export --org org-7312 --from 2025-10-02T17:00Z --to 2025-10-02T19:00Z --types audit,kms-access --out /tmp/org-7312-slice.json
```
Found an export job id: exp-9a7c. There's an entry at 2025-10-02T18:12:35Z showing 'export.initiate' from service-account:svc-data-export. I'll attach slice.

Maya T.: Adding link to ticket with the slice: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-7312 and I uploaded the slice to the ticket. Customer org id is org-7312. ETA to produce redacted evidence and notify: 48 hours if LegalOps signs off today.

Ethan R.: Two follow-ups: 1) check KMS audit for 'sign' or 'decrypt' ops around exp-9a7c; 2) check whether we sent any automated outage/retention emails to the customer in that window. I'll take (1), @Jules can you check product comms for (2)?

Jules C.: On it, checking outbound emails. FYI we have a scheduled retention notice sent on 2025-09-30 to all orgs — not sure if customer saw it.

Maya T.: Thanks team. Will wait for LegalOps approval then send proposed comms draft to customer. :thumbsup:
